# `redundantOrDie`

Suggests hoisting a repeated trailing Effect.orDie from every yield in an Effect generator

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377096`, `TS377097` |
| Language Service name | `redundantOrDie` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/redundant-or-die` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const first: Effect.Effect<number, unknown>
declare const second: Effect.Effect<string, unknown>

export const program = Effect.gen(function*() {
/**
                                  ^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(redundant-or-die): This generator applies `Effect.orDie` to every yielded effect. Hoist it once to the generator result: `Effect.gen(...).pipe(Effect.orDie)`, or `Effect.fn(function*(){ ... }, Effect.orDie)`.
*/
  yield* first.pipe(Effect.orDie)

  return yield* second.pipe(Effect.orDie)
})
```
